description: Prepare first publication or a list-wide update. For new picks use review_items and confirm_items during addition. Publishes nothing. Returns exactly what would become public and, when this connection may publish from chat, a review to confirm with confirm_publication after the owner agrees. Otherwise it returns a browser link where the owner publishes. Show the supplied public URL as a clickable link labeled "Link after publishing", distinct from the owner-only review link. The returned preview is the exact public content: present it as written, with no added images, layouts or caveats.
